Programs & Events

FILM FESTIVALS

Seattle International Film Festival

The 53rd Annual Seattle International Film Festival is happening May 13–23, 2027 at SIFF Cinemas and venues throughout the city.

National Film Festival for Talented Youth (NFFTY)

The National Film Festival for Talented Youth (NFFTY) was founded by three Seattle teenagers in 2007.

FILM SERIES

Scarecrowber

SIFF and Scarecrow video co-present a month long horror series throughout the month of October, or as we like to call it, "Scarecrowber."

PNW Awards

See the nominees for the Seattle Film Critics Society (SFCS) Pacific Northwest Awards (films whose primary production took place in the PNW).

The Films of Andrej Wajda

Marking the 100th anniversary of his birth and the 10th anniversary of his death, SIFF will screen a selection of 8 films from the diverse oeuvre of Polish master Andrzej Wajda. 

Nouvelles Femmes

Bursting with exuberant joie de vivre, young 1960s French writer-directors made dazzling, landmark films celebrating love, rebellion, and the alluring pathways of social-cultural-sexual freedom. 

The Open Road

Hitch a ride, toss your bag in the trunk, and gaze out the window as we drift along thousands of miles of existential terrain.

Holiday Favorites

Annual selection of holiday movies including sing-along screenings and more.

CINEMA PROGRAMS

SIFF Cinema

An ever-rotating selection of movies—in theaters and streaming—to enjoy year-round.

Movie Club

A monthly meet-up with fellow movie-lovers for classic flicks followed by lively discussion.

Book Club

Welcome to SIFF Book Club, a bimonthly screening and meetup that combines bookworms and cinephiles.

$7 Movie Tuesdays

Enjoy $7 tickets for for all Tuesday showtimes!

Community Screenings

Tickets to this series are available $7 for adults and $5 for children!
